root.name: Benoni Defense: Benoni Gambit, Schlenker Defense

overview: Black answers 2.dxc5 with 2...Na6, aiming to win the c5 pawn back with ...Nxc5. After 3.e4 Nxc5 or 3.a4 White gains a space advantage in the centre, while Black has ordinary development. It is a rare line, so the evaluation is unsure.

white_ideas.idea: Defend c5 with a4 or b4, or allow ...Nxc5 and take the centre with e4
Develop with Nc3, e4 and Bf4

black_ideas.idea: Recapture on c5 with the knight or ...Qa5+ and develop
Put pressure on e4 with ...Nf6 and ...g6

typical_structures.structure: White big centre against Black pieces
Open-Sicilian-like but with White pawn on c5

character.notes: White keeps a pawn centre while Black recovers material, so play is steady with a central tension.

gambit.notes: Black regains the pawn on c5 by force with ...Nxc5 or ...e6, so no lasting gambit.

soundness.notes: Equal play after Black recovers the pawn.

structure.notes: A semi-open centre after the c-pawn trade.

level.notes: Plans are simple, but it is a niche line.

character.reason: The pawn comes back by force and the game is level without a clear forcing character.

gambit.reason: Black regains the pawn on c5 almost by force.

soundness.reason: The line is playable with accurate play.

structure.reason: The c-file opens after the c-pawn trade and White gets a centre.

level.reason: Simple plans but a niche line.

plans.reason: There is no clear named plan.
